@gracehill.bsky.social@bsky.brid.gy One of the really scary things about AI... which nobody but programmers seem to realise... is that if you use AI to write programs, then the bus factor of that program is automatically zero. Because the human who "wrote" the program doesn't understand a thing about it... and AIs don't know how to debug anything. They are regurgitating existing programming code which they got from the internet.

#Programming #NoAI
